remarks: Tucked against the Covina foothills, this custom-built single-story estate sits on a horse property spanning over three-quarters of an acre. Manicured landscaping with water features in both the front and back yards sets a tranquil tone from the moment you arrive. Inside, the craftsmanship is in the details: custom front doors, casement windows, ceramic tile and hardwood floors, full trim and casing work on every door and down the hallways, recessed lighting paired with chrome fixtures for a clean, continuous flow.
